# scripts/mutation-pr.sh over a stub gremlins and a small report: the contract with the remediation workflow.
# A lived mutant is one line that starts with "finding: ". The gremlins log lines and the summary line carry no such prefix.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:git] skip
env HOME=$WORK/home
env GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
env GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
chmod 755 fake/gremlins
chmod 755 fake/timeout
env PATH=$WORK/fake:$PATH

# The repository has the module and the script at its top folder, a base commit and a change to a Go source file.
exec git init -q -b main repo
cp a.go repo/a.go
cp gomod repo/go.mod
script mutation-pr.sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh
exec git -C repo add a.go go.mod scripts
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m base
exec git -C repo checkout -q -b change
cp a2.go repo/a.go
exec git -C repo add a.go
exec git -C repo -c user.name=e2e -c user.email=e2e@example.com commit -q -m change

# A report with one lived, one killed, one timed out and one uncovered mutant: one finding line, for the lived one only.
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/lived.json
! exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout -count=1 '^finding: '
stdout '^finding: a.go:3: a mutant lived: CONDITIONALS_NEGATION$'
stdout '^mutation-pr: applied=3 killed=1 lived=1 timed_out=1$'
stdout '^      KILLED CONDITIONALS_NEGATION at a.go:30:4$'
! stdout 'finding: a.go:4'
! stdout 'finding: a.go:5'
! stdout 'finding: a.go:6'
stdout '^mutation-pr: 1 mutant\(s\) lived, 1 finding line\(s\) printed\. Kill each one with a test\.$'

# A report with no lived mutant: the script passes and prints no finding.
env GREMLINS_REPORT=$WORK/clean.json
exec sh repo/scripts/mutation-pr.sh main
stdout '^mutation-pr: applied=1 killed=1 lived=0 timed_out=0$'
! stdout '^finding: '

-- gomod --
module example.com/r

go 1.27
-- a.go --
package a
-- a2.go --
package a

func F(x int) bool { return x > 0 }
func G(x int) int  { return x + 1 }
func H(x int) int  { return -x }
func I(x int)      { x++ }
-- fake/gremlins --
#!/bin/sh
cp "$GREMLINS_REPORT" "$5"
echo "      KILLED CONDITIONALS_NEGATION at a.go:30:4"
-- fake/timeout --
#!/bin/sh
shift 3
exec "$@"
-- lived.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"a.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"LIVED"},{"line":4,"type":"ARITHMETIC_BASE","status":"KILLED"},{"line":5,"type":"INVERT_NEGATIVES","status":"TIMED OUT"},{"line":6,"type":"INCREMENT_DECREMENT","status":"NOT COVERED"}]}]}
-- clean.json --
{"files":[{"file_name":"a.go","mutations":[{"line":3,"type":"CONDITIONALS_NEGATION","status":"KILLED"}]}]}
